title: Cmd-G toggles the current project's grid, and the project grid has a way back to one session

requirements.text: Pressing Cmd-G in one project session shows that project's sessions side by side
requirements.check: manual: relaunch, open a project session, press Cmd-G

requirements.text: Pressing Cmd-G in a project's grid shows the focused session alone with its project's session tabs
requirements.check: manual: in a project grid press Cmd-G

requirements.text: Pressing Cmd-G in the all-projects grid shows only the focused pane's session, in its project
requirements.check: manual: click the top-bar grid button, then press Cmd-G

requirements.text: Clicking the pane-header grid icon while in that project's grid shows that pane's session alone
requirements.check: manual: click the header grid icon twice

requirements.text: The app builds with no errors

evidence: swift build in app/ -> Build complete! (37.66s), no errors; only pre-existing AppUpdater warnings

text: Cmd-G moved to model.toggleProjectGrid (one session -> project grid; any grid -> focused session alone). Top-bar all-projects button keeps its click, lost Cmd-G. Pane-header grid icon toggles back to that pane's session. Builds. Not committed. TJ relaunches and eyes reqs 1-4.
